Everything in one call, mirroring the Psychologist's context. Members already come EXCLUDING whoever opted out of being profiled, and the user's decisions within the window come through here because they aren't in the event log. The engine reads the events themselves straight from Postgres — carrying them over HTTP would be more expensive without being more correct.
